summary: Whether you show it or not, a fast, restless mind and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you overthink it, or talk when you should feel. Owned, you think and talk your way through anything and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
body: Whether you show it or not, a fast, restless mind and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you overthink it, or talk when you should feel. Owned, you think and talk your way through anything and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message. Words may carry extra weight here. Communication can become a way to understand power, protection, and what is left unsaid.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let thinking and speech and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
